description: Move a report through its triage lifecycle (OPEN → IN_REVIEW → ACTIONED | DISMISSED; terminal states reopen to IN_REVIEW). expectedUpdatedAt is REQUIRED — pass the report's updatedAtIso as loaded; a stale token is a typed 409, never a silent overwrite. Completing, closing, and reopening require a note. Receipt-backed. Requires job_feedback:write.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: The report's updatedAtIso exactly as loaded (concurrency token; full ISO-8601 timestamp — date-only strings are rejected).

idempotencyKey.description: Durable-receipt idempotency key. Same key + same payload replays the stored receipt; same key + changed payload is a 409.

name: opentrain_job_feedback_triage
